title: Aquarium Simulator - freshwater and saltwater aquascapes running in your browser! Free and no signup required
author: miimario
selftext:
![img](j22zg1zw6izh1 "https://aquariumsim.io")

Made a little aquarium simulator over the weekend. Got 90% of this working with a single Claude Opus 5.5 prompt. The idea came from wanting to have a nice looking virtual aquarium that could be displayed while my custom calendar/todo list dashboard "sleeps". I first gave Claude Sonnet 5.5 the task of creating a text prompt to build a hyper realistic aquarium simulator and gave it a few base features it needed to have (feeding fish, the ability to put it in a "screensaver" mode, needed to be rendered in the clients browser). I also gave it some creative freedom to include features I had forgotton about, and boy did it take that and run with it. In the spirit of vibe coding, I have tested this minimally before releasing this initial version. I am sure there are optimizations to be made, but for now, it's relaxing to watch the fish swim around.

No registration required, but as a result, saves are local to your browser. Be sure to export your save file if you really care about your tank 😄.  
  
Features: 

* 40+ fish species
* Saltwater and Freshwater tanks
* Build mode where you can adjust substrate, place plants, objects, etc
* Camera mode to export screenshots/video clips of your tank
* Realism mode where water chemistry, hunger, and fish health matter
* Lots more and more to come

Happy aquascaping! 🐠   
[https://aquariumsim.io](https://aquariumsim.io)
